summary:
• Muse Spark Open — Meta's open‑weight mixture‑of‑experts multimodal model that handles text, images, audio and video with a million‑token context, enabling low‑cost, high‑capacity AI on local or cloud hardware.
• Krea 3 — An image‑editing diffusion model that modifies only user‑specified regions, delivering pixel‑perfect edits in seconds at low cost for production pipelines.
• Claude Code — Anthropic's developer assistant receives new retry watchdog, OpenTelemetry tracing, Vim bracket motion and multi‑line terminal input, improving reliability and observability for code generation.
• motionmaxxing — An agent skill that rates AI‑generated video keyframes against curated motion benchmarks and automatically refines timing and easing, producing polished animations without cloud costs.
• new‑term‑radar — A daily GitHub repository that tracks early star spikes to surface emerging AI model and tool terms, giving curators and product teams a cheap early‑warning.
• ChatGPT Chrome extension — The updated extension adds tab‑aware capabilities, letting the assistant read, compare, and act on content across open tabs, streamlining web‑based workflows.
